hud-dumped: Komet HUD: values copied to clipboard and client log
hud-dump-hidden: Komet HUD: nothing to copy, show the HUD (F7) and let its panels draw first
hud-bench-start: Komet HUD: benchmark running for {0} s
hud-bench-done: Komet HUD: benchmark done, results copied to clipboard and client log
cmd-hud-open-failed: Komet HUD: settings window could not be opened
hud-update-mismatch: up to date, but the checksum differs ({0})
hud-update-unverified: up to date, no checksum to compare
hud-update-norelease: {0} is not published on GitHub, nothing to compare with
update-ask: Komet can check on startup whether a newer build is on GitHub and whether the checksum of the installed file matches the published one. That sends one request to api.github.com each time the game starts. Show update notices? You can change this later in the Komet settings (.komet).
verify-match: The installed file matches the checksum published for release {0}.
verify-mismatch: The installed file does NOT match the checksum published for release {0}.
verify-norelease: GitHub has no release {0}, nothing to compare with.
verify-nofile: Loaded from a folder, there is no file to hash.
hud-spikes: Spikes over {0} ms or {1}× average, by cause
hud-spike-line: {0} s: {1} ms, {2} | GC {3} ms, between frames {4} ms, JIT {5} ms, waiting for a core {6} ms | marks: {7}
settings-preset-hint: Sets view distance, shadows, effects, particles and resolution in one go. Changing one of them afterwards makes the preset Custom.
settings-original-hint: Opens the game's own settings screen, as it looks without Komet.
settings-key-hint: Click, then press the key, key combination or mouse button to bind. Escape keeps the old one; a right click puts back the game's default.
settings-reset-hint: Click twice: the first click only asks.
settings-graphicsmenu-hint: Shows this menu instead of the game's settings. Off: the game's own menu.
settings-menublur: Blur the game behind the menu
settings-menublur-hint: The world and the HUD behind this menu, blurred. Off: only darkened.
settings-held: Held at the game's own behaviour while another mod asks for it; your choice applies again once it lets go.
settings-shaderusecache-hint: Uploads only the shader uniforms that changed instead of all of them.
settings-frustumsweep-hint: Culls chunk meshes with vector instructions and a grid, with the engine's result and order. From 8,192 entries per pass the worker threads help.
settings-indirectdraw-hint: Draws chunk batches as indirect commands from a mapped GPU buffer. Needs GL_ARB_multi_draw_indirect; without it the engine draws.
settings-sunocclusion-hint: Reads the sun's occlusion query every fourth frame instead of every frame; under Mesa every glGet is a sync.
settings-windowsizecache-hint: Remembers the window size the engine asks GLFW for a dozen times per frame (on X11 a round trip to the display server).
settings-chunklookup-hint: Answers chunk lookups from a mirror instead of under the lock every client thread takes.
settings-animationframes-hint: Takes animation frames from a cache, otherwise compiles them quickly, otherwise leaves them to the engine.
settings-initonce-hint: Leaves out the second, identical init of the player's shape on every re-tessellation.
settings-shapeinitmemo-hint: Skips repeated inits of entity shapes that did not change.
settings-meshpool-hint: Inserts and removes chunk meshes without walking every pool entry, bit-identical to the engine.
settings-meshrecycle-hint: Recycled meshes keep the arrays the engine allocates anew for every clone.
hud-debuglog: Debug log, last lines of client-debug.log (wheel scrolls, double click grows)
hud-log: Log, last lines of client-main.log (wheel scrolls, double click grows)
hud-modtimes: Mod CPU time per frame: renderers & tick listeners
hud-server-local: Server in this process: client and server patches
hud-conflicts: Conflicts, methods patched by several mods
hud-feature-stooddown: stood down, another mod patches the same code
hud-debug-timings: Debug build – Komet's own timings are inflated roughly 2.6x
hud-cull-sorted: Pools sorted into the grid per frame
hud-draw-unmapped: GL_ARB_buffer_storage missing, command buffer per draw
hud-anim-fast-blocked: Another mod patches the compile, or the game changed it: engine path
hud-entitytess-unpatched: Budget {0} ms - substitution failed, every entity tessellates at once
hud-entitytess-deferred: Put off to a later frame
hud-shapememo-blocked: Another mod patches the shape init, or the game changed it: engine path
hud-particlelight-unpatched: Patch not installed, particles wait as in the engine
hud-particlelight-reads: Light reads on the render thread per frame
hud-particlelight-packed: Chunk packed, not unpacked per frame
hud-extendedrows-unpatched: Rewrite did not match the game's code, the engine copies cell by cell (see log)
hud-extendedrows-blocked: Another mod patches the chunk reads, the engine copies cell by cell
hud-extendedrows-fallbacks: Handed to the engine per frame
hud-visiblefaces-unpatched: Patch not installed, the engine computes every chunk
hud-visiblefaces-other: Another patch on the method, the engine computes every chunk
hud-visiblefaces-engine: Chunks left to the engine (unknown cull mode)
hud-visiblefaces-ported: Cells by the engine's logic (special cull mode, snow)
hud-facelight-unpatched: Patch not installed, the engine lights every face
hud-facelight-other: Another patch on the face light, the engine lights the faces it concerns
hud-facelight-blocks: JSON blocks lit in one pass per frame
hud-tess-unpatched: Counters not installed, tessellation is not measured
hud-tess-partial: A fast path did not match the game's code, the engine's version runs (see log)
hud-tess-occluded-other: Another patch on the tessellation, enclosed chunks go to the engine
hud-tess-zero: Time in chunks without a vertex
hud-tess-skipped: Empty or missing chunks per second
hud-pool-frame-off: Culling on the worker threads failed twice, it stays on the main thread (see log)
hud-tess-workers-failed: Tessellation on a worker thread failed, the engine tessellates alone again (see log)
hud-tess-workers-unpatched: No tessellation on the worker threads: not every safety patch is installed
settings-entitytessbudget-hint: Milliseconds per frame for re-tessellating entities; the rest waits for the next frame. 0 = the engine, all at once.
settings-climatecache-hint: Keeps every climate region in view (up to 144) instead of a fixed 10 regions of 1 MiB each.
hud-prejit-cancelled: Cancelled - world left or switched off
hud-prejit-idle: Not started - switched off at world join
settings-prejit-hint: At world join, on a background thread: fewer JIT stalls the first time something runs.
settings-decompressscratch-hint: Unpacks chunk layers without a throwaway copy: about 8 MB/s less garbage while chunks arrive.
settings-columnnoisescratch-hint: Computes terrain noise with reused arrays. Singleplayer world generation only.
settings-extendedrows-hint: Copies a chunk and its neighbours for the tesselator 32 cells at a time instead of cell by cell.
settings-visiblefaces-hint: Finds visible block faces with a bit formula instead of a case per face.
settings-facelight-hint: Computes block face light (smooth shadows) from bits, four corners at once, without virtual calls.
settings-lightscratch-hint: Spreads block light with reused objects instead of throwaway ones.
settings-particlelight-hint: Particles take the chunk lock only when it is free, otherwise the light read last. Removes long 8-13 ms frames near beehives.
settings-occludedchunks-hint: A chunk enclosed on all sides by opaque blocks yields no vertices and is not tessellated.
settings-tessschedule-hint: Tessellates the nearest chunk first, weighted by view direction, instead of in arrival order. Nearby chunks wait half as long.
settings-workerthreads-hint: Threads for culling and tessellation. 0 = only the game's own threads.
settings-tessjobs-hint: How many worker threads tessellate at once; all of them while a large backlog waits. 0 = none.
hud-garbage-unpatched: A rewrite did not match the game's code, the engine's version runs (see log)
hud-garbage-decompress: Chunk layer copies saved per frame
hud-garbage-noise: Terrain noise arrays saved per frame
settings-uploadcap-hint: Milliseconds per frame for uploading chunks; priority chunks always go. 0 = the engine's own budget, no cap.
hud-uploadcap-active: Upload time cap: {0} ms per frame
hud-uploadcap-off: Upload time cap off, engine budget only
hud-uploadcap-unpatched: Upload time cap {0} ms - substitution failed, engine budget only
